DOMAIN / BINDERS. "Fix the two nearby generic sides of a source simple RIII event" (R_ASSEMBLY_SPEC.md para 2) / "simple transversal Reidemeister-III event … near the wall" (R-PAR-v6 excerpt, Statement): `CV.Event` (CV/Events.lean L411-418: continuous path, CV-generic for t≠0, non-generic at 0 = def:event) + `IsSimpleRIII` (L1131-1140: zero set exactly {G3,G4e,G4f,G4g}, concurrent interior point, transversal) — the accepted CV-event locus of rows 164/167/171/166. ∃ δ with fields over `Punctured E δ t := t.val ≠ 0 ∧ |t.val| < δ` (Cores.lean L586) and cross-wall fields over `OppositeSides E t t' := t.val*t'.val < 0` (L589) with `hs : ∀ s, IsCrossing (E.curve t) s ↔ IsCrossing (E.curve t') s` (proof-irrelevant, supplied by LocalizationData.crossing_set_constant) — the accepted cores' shape. `hn : 3 ≤ n` explicit is not a narrowing (CV fixes n ≥ 3; `three_le_of_h3` X1Rows L148-153 derives it from h3). THE AVAILABILITY SET. R-PAR-v6 (P2) "avail(S') = {x ∈ T : x interlaces no member of S'}" and R_ASSEMBLY_SPEC (1) "𝓐(Q) = {t ∈ T : no element of Q is adjacent to t}" → `avail hP e f g Q = (triangleCrossings P e f g).filter (fun x => ∀ q ∈ Q, ¬ GeometricInterlaces hP q x)` (Cores L448-451), `triangleCrossings = univ.filter (val ∈ {{e,f},{e,g},{f,g}})` (L391-395); adjacency = CV:def:interlace as in `CV.Ind` (Events.lean L165-167: powerset filtered by IsIndepSet of geometricInterlacementGraph). "independent outside support Q in W" → `outsideSupports = CV.Ind.filter (Disjoint Q T)` (L455-458). The local fibre Ind(G_±[𝓐(Q)]) → `localFibre = CV.Ind.filter (J ⊆ avail Q)` (L461-465). Match.

THE SUMMAND AND FIBRE SUM. "F_±(S) the complete summand of CV def:X1 at S on that side, including the selector and every carrier coefficient with the printed empty conventions" → `rowTerm hn hG S := CV.X1Summand hn hG S` (X1Rows L164-165); its content fixed by the PROVED lemmas `rowTerm_of_mem_Ind` (L168-174: = wind(S) * ∏_{q : GeoComponent} Omega1 q for S ∈ Ind) and `rowTerm_of_not_mem_Ind` (L176-180: = 0 otherwise), and `X1_eq_sum_rowTerm` (L182-184) ties it to `CV.X1` (X1.lean L186-188 = def:X1, d1_setup.tex 908-930). Expansion: `wind = ∏ weight` (Carriers L440), `weight = geoCarrierSelector = cornerSelector (geoCornerPolygon)` (Carriers L437; FlatCarriersDefs L466-473: 1 if all turns −1 (right), (−1)^k if all +1 (left), else 0 — def:wind d1:487-517 with c(L) = corner count); carriers = `GeoComponent = Quotient (SameCycle (geoSmoothingSuccessor hP S))`, `geoSmoothingSuccessor = selectedMarkPerm S ≫ geoMarkSuccessor` (FlatCarriersDefs L235-259; def:smoothing); `Omega1 = coeffAt (slot) 0 (groupedPoly)`, `slot = 1 − groupedWrithe − carrierR`, `groupedPoly = ∏_{H ∈ piecesOn q} pieceHomfly`, `groupedWrithe = Σ pieceWrithe = Σ |pieceLabels H|`, `carrierR = rotAbs (geoCornerPolygon)` (X1.lean L79-109); pieces = components of `geometricInterlacementGraph.induce (U hP S)` with `U = univ \ (S ∪ N S)` (Carriers L690-715, Events L171-179; def:pieces d1:519-524), `pieceHomfly = homfly (pieceDiagram)` = positive lift of the piece carrier (PieceCurve L749-755). Match; the far side sums over its own `localFibre (geomAt E t')` at `transportSupport hs Q`, exactly "G_±".

ACROSS THE WALL. "identify the crossing sets with one finite set V" by carrying-edge labels → `transportSupport hs S = S.map (crossingTransport hs).toEmbedding` (FlatCarriersDefs L541-543), `supportEmb hs` its embedding form with `supportEmb_apply : supportEmb hs S = transportSupport hs S` PROVED (X1Rows L223-230); same map as `FibrePartitionData.avail_same` (Cores L1875-1881).

CLAUSE MAP (R_ASSEMBLY_SPEC.md (4) and the following paragraph, ≈L55-64): (i) "At availability zero … the local supports themselves correspond" → `fibre_zero` L550-553: ∀ punctured t, ∀ Q ∈ outsideSupports, card(avail Q) = 0 → localFibre Q = {∅}. (ii) "… or one …" → `fibre_one` L555-559: card = 1 → ∃ z, avail Q = {z} ∧ localFibre Q = {∅,{z}}. (iii) correspondence across the wall → `fibre_correspond` L561-569: for opposite t,t', card ∈ {0,1} → localFibre_{t'} (transportSupport hs Q) = (localFibre_t Q).map (supportEmb hs). These three are the scene-setting sentence (presuppositions: independent subsets of a ≤1-set are the whole power set, `PRE_localFibre_eq_powerset` L271-278; wall-invariance is FibrePartitionData.avail_same); labelled "X₁-free presupposition fields" in the PRE section docstring L599-601 and NOTES_FINAL §12(7). (iv) "but that does not prove their summands agree. Prove the required carrier/record, selector, rotation and coefficient transport" → `summand_transport` L571-580: for every J of the fibre, with hS : Q ∪ J ∈ Ind_t, hS' : transportSupport hs (Q ∪ J) ∈ Ind_{t'} (both provable — FibrePartitionData.compose and the Ind transport; required to type carrierR/Omega1), `SummandTransport` L534-546 = wind_{t'} S' = wind_t S ∧ ∃ τ : GeoComponent_t S ≃ GeoComponent_{t'} S', ∀ q, weight (τ q) = weight q ∧ carrierR (τ q) = carrierR q ∧ groupedWrithe (τ q) = groupedWrithe q ∧ groupedPoly (τ q) = groupedPoly q ∧ Omega1 (τ q) = Omega1 q. Mapping: carrier → τ; record → (w_{S,L}, P_{S,L}) = groupedWrithe/groupedPoly; selector → wind and per-carrier wt; rotation → R(L) = carrierR; coefficient → Ω₁ = Omega1. This is the reading the source's own transport texts use (R_GENERIC_COMMON_TRANSPORT_PROOF.md §1: "grouped polynomials agree. Their grouped writhes also agree … preserves its signed and absolute rotation … preserve its weight by def:wind. … all matched slots, coefficient reads, and weights agree"). (v) "their summands agree" → `summands_agree` L582-590: rowTerm_t (Q ∪ J) = rowTerm_{t'} (transportSupport hs (Q ∪ J)) for every J of the fibre (F_+(Q∪J) = F_−(Q∪J), absent rows 0 on both sides). (vi) (4) "Φ_+(Q) = Φ_−(Q)" → `fibre_identity` L592-597: fibreTerm_t Q = fibreTerm_{t'} (transportSupport hs Q). (vii) "These cases cannot be omitted because the four core proofs assume full availability" → the row's scope hypothesis `card = 0 ∨ card = 1` on every field (card 2 is excluded by FibrePartitionData.avail_card L1918-1921; card 3 = FullAvail, rows 172-177). STRONGER / WEAKER. `summand_transport` and `summands_agree` assert more than the bare identity (4) — but they are exactly the obligations the specification names ("Prove the required carrier/record, selector, rotation and coefficient transport"), so including them is the one-field-per-clause convention, not an over-statement; `fibre_identity` remains the consumer-facing clause and the downgrade path (NOTES_FINAL §3) is recorded. Within `summand_transport` the Lean is, if anything, WEAKER than a literal reading: the record transport is rendered as equality of the grouped record data w_{S,L}, P_{S,L} (not a def:record isomorphism), the rotation transport as |rot| only (def:X1 reads only R(L)), and τ is an existential bijection rather than the canonical mark identification (`GeoMarkTransport.component`, GeoMarkTransport.lean L378-383) — all harmless since def:X1 consumes exactly these quantities. No field narrows the specified domain; `FullAvail` (X1Rows L188-189 = "avail = T", the preamble's definition) is correctly not used by this row.
